title: Female Straight Pose with Hair
author: artbylin
description:
This croquis pack contains a female straight figure (front view) with 12 pre-drawn hairstyles. There are different lengths (including updos) and varying textures (straight/wavy/curly). The figures can be used for hand-drawn or digital fashion illustration (eg. Procreate drawing on iPad). It can help to speed up the illustration/design process.
You will also receive a layered Master File (Adobe Illustrator format) that contains all the hairstyles on separate layers. Play around by toggling the visibility of layers on and off.
————————————————————————
2 FOLDERS + 1 MASTER FILE INCLUDED:
– FOLDER 1: Straight pose in front view with 12 hairstyles. Letter size (8.5 x 11 inches), PNG format
– FOLDER 2: Straight pose in front view with 12 hairstyles. Legal size (11 x 14 inches), PNG format
– MASTER FILE: All hairstyles on separate layers, Adobe Illustrator format (vector)
The vector format will allow you to re-size the figures in Adobe Illustrator without losing detail. Please note that the figures are done in my own style and may not conform to other fashion proportions.
